name: NARASIMHA REDDY M C
headline: HR Recruiter | Talent Acquisition | MBA – Human Resource Management & Marketing
summary: MBA student specializing in Human Resource Management and Marketing at Sanskrithi School of Business, Puttaparthi, with 6 months of hands-on experience as an HR Recruiter Intern at Job Hunter, Bengaluru. Practical knowledge in talent acquisition and recruitment across the end-to-end hiring process, including candidate sourcing on Naukri and LinkedIn, resume screening and shortlisting, interview scheduling and coordination, and candidate database management. Brings a data-driven approach to hiring from a Data Analyst internship using MS Excel, SQL, Python and Power BI.
